summary: Track usage and billing mode by task/run
description: Design and implement lightweight usage/capacity attribution for go runs: runtime kind, billing mode, task/run owner, token/context estimate or API-equivalent cost. Subscription usage must not be presented as invoice cost.
acceptance: Run or evidence records can expose runtime kind, billing mode, task/run owner, and token/context or API-equivalent cost estimate when available.
Billing mode distinguishes api, subscription, free, and unknown.
Subscription/free usage may show API-equivalent cost but is not labeled as provider invoice cost.
Regression coverage proves cost/billing labels preserve the distinction.
